# DrillTime

> DrillTime is a bilingual English and Arabic music practice app for iPhone and iPad, made for young musicians and their teachers. It combines a metronome, a tempo trainer and a rhythm-reading trainer.

## About the app

- Metronome: time signatures, accents, swing and several click sounds.
- Speed Builder: a tempo trainer that raises the tempo gradually.
- Rhythm Shuffler: a rhythm-reading trainer with six difficulty levels.
- Full English and Arabic interfaces, with right-to-left layout in Arabic.
- Works offline. No sign-up or login.
- Collects no personal data: no analytics, no tracking and no advertising. Practice settings stay on the device.
- Pricing model: a one-time purchase, with no subscription and no ads.
- Developer: Phil Doughty.

## Pages

- [Home](https://drilltimeapp.com/): overview of the app, its features and frequently asked questions
- [Privacy Policy](https://drilltimeapp.com/privacy): what the app does and does not collect (it collects no personal data)
- [Terms of Use](https://drilltimeapp.com/terms): the terms that apply to using the app
- [Support](https://drilltimeapp.com/support): how to contact the developer by email, plus common help topics

## Feature pages

- [Metronome](https://drilltimeapp.com/metronome): what the metronome does, how to use it, a 20-minute practice routine and key terms
- [Speed Builder](https://drilltimeapp.com/speed-builder): raising tempo step by step from a start tempo to a goal tempo, with a sample plan
- [Rhythm Shuffler](https://drilltimeapp.com/rhythm-shuffler): reading a fresh rhythm, tapping it back and checking timing accuracy, with common note values
- [Metronome, in Arabic](https://drilltimeapp.com/ar/metronome): the metronome page in Arabic
- [Speed Builder, in Arabic](https://drilltimeapp.com/ar/speed-builder): the Speed Builder page in Arabic
- [Rhythm Shuffler, in Arabic](https://drilltimeapp.com/ar/rhythm-shuffler): the Rhythm Shuffler page in Arabic, with Arabic note names

## Practice guides

- [Practice guides](https://drilltimeapp.com/guides): index of the practice guides for students, parents and teachers
- [How to practise with a metronome](https://drilltimeapp.com/guides/metronome-practice): choosing a starting tempo, when to speed up, common mistakes and a one-week tempo ladder
- [How to build speed without making mistakes](https://drilltimeapp.com/guides/build-speed): short passages, small tempo steps, staying relaxed and a five-day plan
- [How to help your child practise every day](https://drilltimeapp.com/guides/daily-practice-for-kids): advice for parents on daily habits, practice time by age and what to say
- [Practice guides, in Arabic](https://drilltimeapp.com/ar/guides): the guides index in Arabic
- [How to practise with a metronome, in Arabic](https://drilltimeapp.com/ar/guides/metronome-practice): the metronome practice guide in Arabic
- [How to build speed without making mistakes, in Arabic](https://drilltimeapp.com/ar/guides/build-speed): the speed-building guide in Arabic
- [How to help your child practise every day, in Arabic](https://drilltimeapp.com/ar/guides/daily-practice-for-kids): the guide for parents in Arabic
